description: Fork of exp696 (1.4247 @ 100.7M, <150M SOTA) with embedding_dim 144 -> 96; d_v stays at 24. H*d_v=144 != E=96, so out_proj becomes asymmetric (input=144, output=96). Expected ~89.65M params (-11M vs exp696): tok_emb_E -1.57M, out_proj -1.57M/layer. Isolates the E-shrink cost vs exp706 (E=96, d_v=16; 1.4371 @ 84.94M, -12 mb vs exp696). If exp707 ~ exp696, d_v cut was load-bearing; if exp707 ~ exp706, E cut was. Targets <90M tier. Comparison anchors: exp696=1.4247 @ 100.7M, exp706=1.4371 @ 84.94M, exp693=1.4379 @ 97.5M.
